features.feature: The My notes button on a call toggles its panel (right by default); with no call open it says "Open a call to take notes for it"
A note typed and Enter is added as Note, ? Question, ! Decision or ☐ To-do, and the panel says "Saved"
A to-do's box ticks it done and back
A note edited in place changes text and kind (Enter saves, Esc cancels); an edit that empties it is dropped and the note kept; × deletes it
Edit as text shows `my-notes.md` itself; a line starting with # becomes a heading in the timeline; ← Timeline goes back
Notes are saved to the call's `my-notes.md` a second after typing and on blur; an unchanged text is never written again
A note typed but not added is added and saved when another call opens, Write minutes is pressed, or the window closes
Notes show as dots on transcript turns and as callouts under the minutes line of the same time (else the nearest within 3 min), never written into the minutes

An unreadable `my-notes.md` says so with Show folder; a file changed outside while a note is typed (in the box, in place or as text) keeps the user's notes with the note and the other version as `my-notes.<HHMMSS>.md` and says where

While recording, a note is timed from its first key, the time kept once the app confirms it records the call (a note typed in the seconds after hang-up gets none; the box never waits, Add at most 500 ms); Time inserts the call's time, likewise once the app confirms it records the call (else it says the call has ended, or that it couldn't confirm it); Flag marks the moment; notes from the tray or `echoctl note` join them
Notes that can't be saved show Retry; closing the window with unsaved notes asks "Try again / Close without saving"

The timeline stays where it was scrolled when the panel is drawn again (a live update, a note added, the time in the note box), following new entries when scrolled to its end; another call's opens at its top. Each note's time is a small chip inline before its text, as in the minutes
